description: This file contains functions for setting up and managing onboarding skills in the OpenClaw project, including handling skill installation, status reporting, user prompts, and configuration updates.

methods.name: summarizeInstallFailure
methods.description: Summarizes and trims install failure messages to a maximum length.

methods.name: formatSkillHint
methods.description: Creates a descriptive hint string for a skill, combining description and install label.

methods.name: upsertSkillEntry
methods.description: Updates or inserts a skill entry in the configuration object.

methods.name: setupSkills
methods.description: Main function to configure, install, and set up skills based on user prompts and system status.
